# AI Assembly Line Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/AI_START_HERE.md` before responding to a new product idea.

For a rough idea with no established lifecycle state:

- do not brainstorm the product
- do not produce an MVP, feature list, stack, architecture, repository layout, or tasks
- activate `prompts/08-project-workspace-initializer.md` and `prompts/00-intake-interviewer.md`
- respond only with a short acknowledgement, compact status, and one A/B/C question asking whether the project is greenfield, already has a repository, or is planning-only
- stop after that question

Use merged repository artifacts and PR state to select later roles. Do not infer lifecycle completion from chat history.
